inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: Q3-2026 10-Q weighted-average diluted shares (275.278M; basic outstanding 274.379M at 2026-09-30 per cover page). Already includes the ~3.2M shares issued to Hexagon in Feb-2026. Held FLAT because SBC (incl. equity-award withholding taxes) is fully expensed in the flows; no further non-SBC issuance modelled.
inputs.sbc_source: 10-K FY2025 and 10-Q Q3-2026 cash-flow statements. TTM to 2026-09-30 = FY2025 + 9M26 - 9M25. SBC add-back 455.2 + 429.8 - 342.0 = 543.0; 'Stock received for payment of employee taxes on vesting of restricted stock' (financing) 169.8 + 195.6 - 148.1 = 217.3; summed = 760.3 because Cadence publishes no combined SBC-incl-withholding figure (its non-GAAP reconciliation adds back the expense only).
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate. 10y UST ~4.2% + beta ~1.05 x ERP 4.5% = ~8.9%; debt is ~3% of EV so WACC ~= cost of equity. 9.0% in all three scenarios -- risk is carried by the scenario paths and weights, not by a per-scenario WACC premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: Operating-lease cost stays inside EBITDA (opex); lease liabilities ($186M FY2025) are NOT in net debt. One treatment, charged once.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon (routing table row 1: operating software/EDA company; no memory entry -- first valuation). FY0 = FY2026E revenue at the midpoint of the raised guidance ($6.387-6.417B, Q3-2026 call 2026-10-26) because ten of twelve months are reported and the year is guided; year 1 = FY2027. Net debt is the 2026-09-30 balance sheet (Senior Notes carrying 2,483.2 incl. 2027 Notes current 498.8, revolver 150.0, less cash 1,452.0); Q4-2026 cash generation is therefore not credited (small conservatism). Marketable debt (80.7) and equity (10.5) securities are added in equity_bridge. last_fcf = TTM to Q3-2026 owner FCF: reported FCF 1,763.5 (OCF 1,967.9 - PP&E capex 204.4) - SBC incl. withholding 760.3 - interest income 0 = 1,003.2 (16.4% of TTM revenue 6,132). FY2025 owner FCF was 961.9 after the $140.6M DOJ/BIS export-control settlement payment. interest_income set to 0: the company is now net DEBT ($1.18B) after funding the $2.2B cash leg of Hexagon D&E, so there is no cash pile to double count; the flows are built unlevered from EBITDA and net debt is deducted once. Buybacks: a genuine repurchaser ($925M FY2025, $800M 9M-2026, new $2.5B authorization 2026-10-23) -- the flat count is funded, not a convention. Adjusted EBITDA here = GAAP operating income + D&A + SBC + restructuring + settlement loss (FY2023 42.4%, FY2024 42.5%, FY2025 44.0%, 9M-2026 43.9%); it is pre-SBC and SBC is then charged at the combined rate. Working capital: Cadence's OCF has run $110-220M/yr below EBITDA+SBC-cash tax-net interest in FY2023-25 (receivables, unbilled, emulation-hardware inventory), i.e. roughly -20% to -28% of the revenue increase, so wc_capture is NEGATIVE despite deferred revenue. Cash tax: 20% FY2023, 37% FY2024 (Sec.174 capitalisation), 15% FY2025 (OBBBA R&D expensing catch-up), ~34% 9M-2026 on the model EBIT; 26% is the through-cycle rate on an EBIT that already deducts non-deductible withholding taxes. D&A path falls as Hexagon/BETA acquired intangibles (amortisation 9M-2026 $122M) roll off; capex ~3% (FY2025 2.7%, 9M-2026 3.5%). Revenue growth is treated as organic-plus-tuck-in; acquisition spend is not deducted, which is a known generosity for a serial acquirer (see key risks).

equity_bridge.item: Marketable debt + equity securities at fair value
equity_bridge.note: Q3-2026 10-Q: debt securities 80.7 (market-risk note), marketable equity 10.5 (fair-value table)

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: owner_fcf_5yr_cagr (FY2020 502.8 -> FY2025 961.9). Equity CAGR rejected as primary: book value is distorted by buybacks and by acquisition-related equity, and the 3yr figure (25.9%) diverges far from EPS.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 25.9% vs EPS 3yr 9.3% and revenue 3yr 14.1% -- divergence >30%; equity is not used as the growth anchor.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - equity-award withholding taxes; interest income not stripped, company not materially net cash): FY2020 502.8, FY2022 736.4, FY2025 961.9. Owner-FCF 3yr CAGR 9.3% is 3.1pp below reported FCF 3yr CAGR 12.4%: SBC plus withholding grew from 382 (FY2022) to 625 (FY2025), so a rising share of reported growth is paid for in stock. FY2025 owner FCF is also depressed by the $140.6M export-control settlement. Revenue CAGRs include M&A (BETA CAE 2024, Hexagon D&E 2026).

base.growth_rationale: FY2027 13% = ~11-12% organic (record $8.2B backlog, AI/custom-silicon design starts) + two extra months of Hexagon D&E; decelerating 1pp/yr to 4% by FY2036 against a 14-15% 3-5yr revenue CAGR that included M&A.
base.ebitda_margin_rationale: Pre-SBC EBITDA 44.0% FY2025 / 43.9% 9M-2026 (Hexagon dilutive). Guidance raised non-GAAP op margin to 44.2-45.2%; +0.5pp/yr as acquired SD&A margins are integrated, maturing at 47%.
base.sbc_pct_rationale: SBC 9.2% + withholding taxes ~3.2% of revenue = ~12.4% 2026; drifts down 0.2pp/yr to 11% -- SBC% has risen, not fallen, since 2018, so the glide is slow.

scenario_narratives.base: AI-driven custom-silicon demand (hyperscaler ASICs, chiplets/3D-IC) keeps Core EDA and IP growing low-teens near term on a record $8.2B backlog, Hexagon D&E is integrated into SD&A without further margin dilution, and the EDA oligopoly with Synopsys and Siemens holds pricing. Growth fades from 13% to 4% over the decade as the AI design cycle normalises; pre-SBC EBITDA margin recovers from the Hexagon dip to 47%; SBC plus withholding stays ~11-12% of revenue because talent cost is the business.
scenario_narratives.bull: The silicon-to-systems strategy works: BETA CAE plus Hexagon give Cadence a multiphysics/system-simulation franchise that competes head-on with Synopsys-Ansys, AI design tools (Cerebrus/Verisium, NVIDIA collaboration) are monetised as premium pricing rather than cannibalised, and China export licensing stays available under the trade truce. Mid-teens growth for five years, operating leverage takes pre-SBC EBITDA margin to 50%, and SBC intensity eases toward 10%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Two of the Analysis JSON's named risks bite together: China (~15-16% of revenue) is lost to renewed EDA export licensing and state-backed domestic EDA, while agentic AI design tools (the 'Kimi K3' scare) erode seat pricing and pull the semiconductor R&D cycle forward into a downturn after the AI capex peak. Growth falls to mid/high single digits, the Synopsys-Ansys combination presses SD&A pricing so Hexagon stays margin-dilutive (EBITDA drifts to 43%), and SBC stays ~12% as Cadence pays to retain engineers. Lower exit cap (15x) and 2.5% terminal growth.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 20% (above the 15% default): China export-control exposure is a single-regulator dependency under DOJ probation, and the AI-disintermediation tail is unproven but non-trivial. Base 50%: guidance has been raised three times and backlog is a record, so the central path is well evidenced. Bull 30% (below the 35% default): it needs AI-design demand to persist, Hexagon integration to succeed AND margin expansion against Synopsys-Ansys -- several independent things going right.

valuation_philosophy.summary: House basis expenses SBC and the cash withheld on net-share settlement (~12% of revenue combined) and holds the diluted count flat; this is the dominant difference from street valuations of Cadence, which add SBC back. Flows are unlevered from a pre-SBC EBITDA build with negative working-capital capture, discounted at a 9% USD WACC over 10 years with a Gordon/cap terminal value.
key_risks_to_valuation: Terminal value carries most of the value at 9% WACC and 3% growth; each 1pp of WACC moves value by roughly a fifth (see sensitivity).

Serial M&A (BETA CAE, Hexagon $3.0B, Secure-IC, Arm Artisan IP) supports revenue growth but acquisition spend is not deducted from owner FCF -- if growth needs ~$0.5-1B/yr of deals, the model is generous.
Cash tax rate is volatile (15%-37% of model EBIT across FY2023-2026) from Sec.174/OBBBA timing and Pillar 2; 26% is a through-cycle assumption.
China export-control and DOJ-probation exposure (~15-16% of revenue).
Agentic/general-purpose AI could compress EDA seat pricing over the terminal period.
Combined SBC plus withholding (~12% of revenue) may not decline; treating it as non-cash roughly adds the street-basis premium shown in band_position.
